purpose: Historical source-grounded candidate exposures for CORE research. Not a forecast or a validated security selection rule.

selection_policy.as_of: Choose only the issuer version with valid_from <= decision_time < valid_to_exclusive when an end exists; reject absent or stale versions.
selection_policy.validity_meaning: Pipeline knowledge availability windows, not operational start/end dates. All source information must itself be available before decision time.
selection_policy.pre_2024: No exposure version available. Historical episodes before these first valid_from values must abstain until older filings are separately researched.
selection_policy.no_backfill: Never apply FY2025 facts to 2024/2025 events. Annual report dates differ from report-period dates.
selection_policy.latest_update: Annual snapshots only; intervening 10-Q, 8-K and IR disclosures still need per-event review.
selection_policy.unknown_policy: Unknown effect or quantity is not zero exposure, no offset, or proof of immateriality.
